$comment: UCOS-UFEP-001 — UNIVERSAL FREEZE ELIGIBILITY PROGRAMME (declaration). This file is DATA and
is the ONLY place the freeze state vocabulary, the transition set, the CEP-007 preconditions,
the freeze subjects, the frozen-baseline manifests, the repository completion criteria, the
validation dimensions and the exit criteria are stated. ufep_engine.py contains no state
name, no subject identifier, no precondition name and no criterion: everything it measures
and determines is read from here and from the LOCATED determinations named here.
WHAT THIS PROGRAMME DETERMINES, AND WHAT IT REFUSES TO DO. CEP-007 Article IV makes freeze
ELIGIBILITY a decidable property of an artifact, and Article V fixes its five preconditions.
This programme measures those preconditions and determines eligibility. It does NOT freeze.
CEP-007 VII.1 reserves the freeze DECISION to Freeze Authority, I.5 provides that Freeze
Authority is never self-conferred by Execution Authority, and this engine is derived truth.
The freeze states beyond ELIGIBLE are therefore declared unreachable by this programme, and a
self-guard fails closed if any subject is ever reported in one.
WHY ELIGIBILITY IS ATTAINABLE WHILE FINALITY IS NOT. CEP-007 III.2 admits an artifact to the
freeze lifecycle when it is RATIFIED under CEP-006 in any of three states — the two in-corpus
acceptance states and the terminal finality state — and IV.1 requires only that the
ratification not be REJECTED. Freeze eligibility therefore does not require constitutional
finality. The located foundation freeze authorization reaches the same determination from the
other direction, recording that the standing finality condition is carried forward and is
'not a freeze blocker'. This programme cites that clause rather than reasoning around it.
THE BAND-SCOPE CONDITION IS DISCLOSED, NOT ABSORBED. A located determination records that a
BAND-scope freeze is NOT READY pending a band certification step. Band freeze is a different
scope from the per-artifact eligibility CEP-007 Article IV defines, is owned by another
programme, and is NOT closed here. Finding UFEP-F-002 discloses it, and the determination
this programme emits is explicitly scoped to the artifacts holding canonical ratification
records.

programme.name: Universal Freeze Eligibility Programme
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme freezes nothing, seals no baseline, transitions no artifact and holds no Freeze Authority. It measures the CEP-007 Article V preconditions against located determinations and reports the Article IV eligibility they decide.
programme.disclosure: **DISCLOSURE.** CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL. This programme determines freeze ELIGIBILITY under CEP-007 Article IV for the artifacts holding canonical ratification records. It performs no freeze, and it does not determine band-scope or programme-scope freeze readiness, which are owned elsewhere and disclosed as findings.

$state_comment: The freeze state vocabulary, projected from the located clause. Each state must appear in
that clause. reachable_by_this_programme marks the only transition a derived-truth engine may
make: the determination of eligibility. Everything past it requires Freeze Authority acting
on an authorization, which this engine neither holds nor can confer.

state_basis.anchor: VI.1 The freeze states SHALL be: NOT_ELIGIBLE, ELIGIBLE, FREEZING, FROZEN, SUPERSEDED.

transition_basis.anchor: VI.3 The legal freeze transitions SHALL be exactly:

$eligibility_comment: The eligibility rule and the admission rule, both bound to their located clauses. The
admission clause is the one that makes eligibility attainable while finality is not: it names
the ratification states that admit an artifact to the freeze lifecycle.

eligibility_basis.anchor: IV.1 An artifact SHALL be eligible for freeze only when it is VALIDATED (CEP-004), CERTIFIED (CEP-005, active), and RATIFIED (CEP-006, not REJECTED).

admission_basis.anchor: RATIFIED under CEP-006 (ACCEPTED, PROVISIONAL, or FINALIZED)

decidability_basis.anchor: IV.2 Eligibility SHALL be decidable: an artifact is either eligible or not eligible, with no intermediate condition.

unverifiable_basis.anchor: V.4 A precondition that cannot be verified SHALL be treated as unsatisfied until it is made verifiable.

$precondition_comment: The five CEP-007 Article V preconditions. Two are per-subject and are evidenced by a located
determination naming that subject; three are repository-wide and are read from the machine
model of the programme that owns them. A precondition whose source cannot be read is
UNSATISFIED, never assumed — that is CEP-007 V.4, bound above.

precondition_basis.anchor: V.1 Freeze SHALL require, as preconditions: closed validation (CEP-004), active certification (CEP-005), an accepted ratification (CEP-006), rooted-and-closed traceability (CEP-001 Article XVIII), and proven determinism such that the artifact is reproducible (CEP-001 Article XX).

$source_comment: Machine models this programme reads. Every one is the sealed output of a located programme
that owns the condition; none is re-derived here. A source that does not resolve makes every

sources.$comment: At most one standing ceiling entry is permitted, and it is the out-of-corpus finality condition CEP-006 I.4 makes permanent. A SECOND entry means a new certification blocker has appeared, and completion fails closed.
A tier-limited certifier run excludes blocking checks and says so in its own ceiling. Completion may only be determined against a FULL-tier model, so the tier is measured rather than assumed.

$subject_comment: Freeze subjects. Each subject is an artifact that holds a canonical ratification record in
the located ratification registry — CEP-007 III.2 admits nothing else to the freeze
lifecycle. The ratification precondition is therefore READ from the registry, never declared
here. Only the two per-subject preconditions CEP-007 V.1 assigns to CEP-004 and CEP-005 are
bound here, each to a located determination naming that subject and to the verbatim phrase in
which that determination records its verdict.

certification_evidence.anchor: the enforcement gate and freeze lineage are intact and append-only

$baseline_comment: CEP-007 Article VIII: a baseline is content-addressed, reproducible, and a pure function of
the frozen artifact, its bound evidence references and its ratification record. This
programme COMPUTES such a baseline for every eligible subject so the baseline a freeze would
seal is knowable and reproducible before any freeze occurs. Computing a baseline is not
sealing one: nothing here is recorded as FROZEN, and the version is content-addressed so it
cannot drift from the material it summarises (VIII.2, VIII.3, XIV.1).

baseline_basis.anchor: VIII.2 A baseline SHALL be a pure function of the frozen artifact, its bound evidence references, and its ratification record, computed deterministically.

freeze_record_basis.anchor: XVII.1 A freeze record SHALL record the artifact, the Freeze Authority, the preconditions satisfied, the baseline digest, the version, the lineage, the state, and the program-state hash.

$drift_comment: CEP-007 Article X: a no-drift guard SHALL verify that every frozen artifact matches its
recorded baseline. This repository already holds a located frozen baseline manifest. The
guard below recomputes every digest in it and compares. Detected drift is a violation that
closes the gate — X.3 requires it to place the Program in HALTED, and a closed gate is how
this programme expresses that without asserting an authority it does not hold.

drift_basis.anchor: X.2 A no-drift guard SHALL verify that every frozen artifact matches its recorded baseline and that every baseline is registered.

$authorization_comment: CEP-007 XX / I.5: Freeze Authority acts only upon an authorization and never self-confers.
A located freeze authorization exists in this repository. It is RECORDED here as evidence
that the authorization channel is occupied — this programme does not act on it, and could
not: it holds no Freeze Authority.

subject, by the CEP-007 Article V preconditions.

findings.title: Freeze eligibility was undecidable because no programme measured the CEP-007 Article V preconditions
findings.note: CEP-007 IV.2 requires eligibility to be decidable and V.2 requires every precondition to be machine-verifiable. Nothing in the repository measured them together, and one of the five — an accepted ratification — could not be measured at all because the registry CEP-006 mandates did not exist. Closed by measuring all five from the located determinations and machine models that own them, and by treating an unreadable source as unsatisfied per V.4.

findings.title: A located determination records BAND-scope freeze as NOT READY; that scope is not closed here
findings.note: Band freeze requires a band certification-of-certifications step that a located determination records as the next lawful frontier and as not yet performed. That is a different scope from the per-artifact eligibility CEP-007 Article IV defines, and it is owned by the Band-13 programme. This programme's determination is explicitly scoped to the artifacts holding canonical ratification records, and it neither absorbs nor contradicts the band-scope determination.

findings.title: Eligibility is not a freeze, and this programme cannot become one
findings.note: CEP-007 VII.1 reserves the freeze decision to Freeze Authority and I.5 forbids its self-conferral by Execution Authority. Every state past eligibility is declared unreachable by this programme and a self-guard fails closed if any subject is reported in one. The located freeze authorization is recorded as evidence that the authorization channel is occupied; it is not acted upon here.

findings.title: Constitutional completion is completion of the machinery, not constitutional finality
findings.note: CEP-006 I.4 caps every in-corpus determination at provisional acceptance pending an out-of-corpus finality authority, and the located freeze authorization records that this standing condition is carried forward and is not a freeze blocker. Constitutional completion as determined here therefore means: every constitutional condition the repository is competent to decide is decided, measured, owned and gated. It does not mean, and must never be read as, constitutional finality.

findings.title: The completion determination is downstream of the aggregate certifier and is deliberately not one of its checks
findings.note: This programme reads the aggregate certifier's sealed model to decide three of its completion criteria. Binding its determination as a check inside that certifier would make the certifier a component of its own input, reproducing the recursion topology this repository forbids elsewhere. Only this programme's SELF-guards are bound there, as G-21. The determination itself is gated by its own Makefile target and CI workflow, which run the certifier at full tier first — and criterion UFEP-CC-11 measures that the model it read was in fact a full-tier one, so a tier-limited model cannot silently produce a completion verdict.
